text: {"lessons":["I sold Stock A repeatedly after large gains, suggesting I may be taking profits for the emotional reward; I should base future sales on my plan and the portfolio’s risks, not my purchase price.","My account value fluctuated despite my trades and later inaction; short-term results don’t show that a decision was good or bad, especially when prices are unpredictable.","Since I rarely check the account and don’t need to trade often, I can avoid impulsive reactions and make deliberate decisions when holdings or portfolio balance genuinely warrant them."]}
